title: Implement core-owned CharacterSheet model, store, projection, and CLI migration
description: Implements ADR 0011 (eshyra-lupf.13). Evolve FinalizedCharacter into a versioned, root-exported core CharacterSheet document. Add a core-owned CharacterSheetStore (save/load/list) backed by SQLite — a character_sheet table keyed by character id with schema_version / system / rules_pack_id columns plus a sheet_json document column. Implement the sheet -> live 'character' row projection (sheet authors identity/class/level/hp_max; live row keeps hp_current/conditions). Switch CLI creation/selection wiring (packages/cli/src/index.ts, playCharacter.ts) from createFileFinalizedCharacterStore to the core store, and add a best-effort one-time importer for any existing finalized-character JSON files. Demote/remove the CLI JSON store as authoritative.
acceptance_criteria:
- Core exports a versioned CharacterSheet type (evolved from FinalizedCharacter) and a CharacterSheetStore with SQLite-backed default.
- character_sheet table persists schema_version/system/rules_pack_id + sheet_json; reads validate pack binding.
- sheet->live-row projection keeps level/hp_max/identity in sync; per-turn hp_current/conditions remain owned by the live row.
- CLI creation/selection use the core store; existing CLI finalized JSON files are migrated; CLI JSON persistence is no longer authoritative.
- Tests cover round-trip persistence, projection, pack-binding validation, and migration.
close_reason: All children (.14.1–.14.4) delivered and merged to main (PRs #326/#328/#331/#333). Core-owned CharacterSheet model, store, projection, CLI cutover, custody lifecycle, and timeline conflict-resolution UX complete.
